notes.title: V. 1.01 PATCH: That's a Strike for Me!
notes.notes:
Just cleaning up the bugs that Huw Miller caught in his Twitch stream the other day! Thanks, Huw!

- Corrected typos
- Fixed glitch with how avatars are displayed in Case #3
- Fixed glitch with how strikes displayed at the end of Case #3
- Fixed glitch with how strikes displayed at the end of Case #4

If you'd like you can check out the VOD here (https://www.twitch.tv/videos/977937315), which includes some behind-the-scenes commentary in the chat from the game's programmer, Paul Franzen.
